lines.en: Is the soup ready?
Almost. Ten more minutes, probably.
lines.ko: 거의 다 됐어요. 아마 십 분 더요.

lines.en: It smells quite good.
Thank you. Did you call our granddaughter?
Yes, this morning. She sounded so happy.
lines.ko: 네, 오늘 아침에요. 아주 기뻐하는 목소리였어요.

lines.en: Will you help me with the table?
Certainly. Where do you want the flowers?
In the middle, please. She especially loves yellow ones.
lines.ko: 가운데에 놔 주세요. 손녀가 특히 노란 꽃을 좋아해요.

lines.en: Perhaps we need another chair.
You are right. I will bring one now.

dialogs.about: 시장 과일 가게에서 사과를 고르며 이야기해요

lines.en: Hello! These apples came in this morning.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 이 사과는 오늘 아침에 들어왔어요.

lines.en: They look good. Are they sweet?
Very sweet. Please try one.
Oh, it's quite sweet. Thank you.
Do you need them for a pie?
Yes. Which ones are best for baking?
lines.ko: 네. 어떤 게 굽기에 제일 좋아요?

lines.en: These red ones, especially.
I made a pie last weekend. It's completely gone.
lines.ko: 지난 주말에 파이를 만들었어요. 다 없어졌어요.

lines.en: Then you probably need more apples.
Yes, exactly ten, please. I will come again.
lines.ko: 네, 정확히 열 개 주세요. 또 올게요.
